title: The report guard's model-name check matches every spawn of a role this session made, not only the latest
why: Twice (06:50 and 07:06 CST Nov 8, lane verdict-format-line, #1913 comments 6721647283 and 6721711063) the Stop hook said 'reviewer sonnet' matched no reviewer spawn, which ran haiku: round 1 was a haiku reviewer, rounds 2 and 3 sonnet reviewers earlier in the session. Lane builder-report-in-head hit the same at 06:58 CST. It also fired 'no model named for builder' and 'for test-author' on items the session wrote itself.
note: Done check: red tests where a Done item naming 'reviewer sonnet' passes when any reviewer spawn this session ran sonnet, and a Done item with no agent work needs no model. Related: steps report-guard-role-default-model (#1919) and report-model-from-role. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug and title by triage.
